Messages.Author: badger
Messages.Body:
Dear LSJ,

Does stealing all of a vampire's blood, burn him/her? If yes, is the
vampire burned when it reaches zero or does the stolen blood have to
reduce it to negative blood?

The original Jyhad rule book says no, but the newer V:TES book says
yes. I checked the up to date rules reference/errata posted on the net,
but it did not make mention of either.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <350C2F...@buffnet.net>,


From the errata post (4th bullet):

* Stealing all of the blood from a vampire will not
burn the vampire in the advanced (full) game
(errata). [RTR]
